items.title: Apple同步推出macOS與iOS/iPadOS 27.2版，修補286個漏洞
items.summary: Apple於10月26日同步推出macOS Golden Gate與iOS/iPadOS的27.2版，兩份安全公告分別列出263個與163個漏洞，合計426個，由於約有140個漏洞同時影響兩組系統，扣除重複項目後，涉及的獨立漏洞共286個。

items.title: Cloudflare AI服務快取出錯，155次GLM-5.3回答混入他人資料
items.summary: Cloudflare公布旗下AI服務Workers AI的資料外洩調查結果，指出8月27日至9月9日期間，GLM-5.3模型共有155次回應混入其他客戶的資料。問題發生在處理特別長的輸入內容時，Cloudflare已於9月9日完成修復，確認其他Workers AI模型未受影響，也沒有發現有人蓄意利用漏洞的證據。

items.title: Amazon修訂軟體工程師職務指引，強調AI時代應重成果而非Token用量
items.summary: Amazon周二（10/27）公布新版軟體開發工程師（SDE）職務指引，重新界定AI時代工程師的角色與工作要求。Amazon強調，儘管AI正快速改變軟體開發方式，衡量工程師表現仍應以實際工作成果為主，而非AI工具採用率、Token用量或程式碼數量。

items.title: 2026年資安技能金盾獎初賽登場，224隊爭奪決賽資格
items.summary: 數位發展部資通安全署偕同國家資通安全研究院，於10月17日在北、中、南三地舉辦第21屆（2026年）資安技能金盾獎初賽。本屆共有224隊報名，創歷屆新高，將選出大專院校組30隊及國高中職組10隊，合計40隊晉級決賽。

items.title: NIST發布PQC遷移路線圖，自2031年起RSA等傳統公鑰演算法逐步退場，2036年起禁用
items.summary: 隨著後量子密碼學（PQC）標準逐步確立，既有系統升級與傳統公鑰演算法汰換，成為政府與企業面臨的重要課題。

items.title: Magento、Brotli漏洞遭積極利用
items.summary: 10月27日美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）表示，他們根據掌握漏洞遭到積極利用的證據，將兩個新漏洞加入已遭利用的漏洞名單（KEV）。

items.title: fix: prevent model fallback from replaying deliberate CLI handoffs (#…
items.summary: fix: prevent model fallback from replaying deliberate CLI handoffs (#186660) fix(agents): don't fall back when a CLI backend yields on purpose When a CLI-backend run deliberately yielded with sessions_yield, the result classifier treated the missing final answer as an empty result and replayed the turn on the fallback model. An intentional yield is now excluded from fallback; real CLI failures still fall back. Evidence: built Gateway with the real Claude Code executable against a local Messages fixture. A spawned child that called sessions_yield was replayed on the fallback model on main (twice); with this change there were zero fallback requests (twice), and the continuation resumed the native session and finished with agent.wait status ok. A genuine native CLI rejection still fell back on both refs. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/186660#issuecomment-6466603483. Thanks @Marvinthebored. Co-authored-by: Marvinthebored Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix: preserve escaped-bang links in fetched text (#183532)
items.summary: fix: preserve escaped-bang links in fetched text (#183532) fix(web-fetch): keep links whose text starts with an escaped bang web_fetch's Markdown cleanup treated a link written as \![label](url) as an image marker and dropped the label, so fetched pages lost link text. An escaped bang (an odd number of backslashes) now stays a plain link; real images and even-backslash images are unchanged. Evidence: built Gateway, authenticated /tools/invoke with the registered web_fetch tool, and real HTTP Markdown fixtures. Main lost the escaped-bang link label (twice); with this change it was kept (twice). Ordinary links, ordinary images, even-backslash images and three-backslash links behave as expected across all 20 calls. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/183532#issuecomment-6465230950. Thanks @zechen5. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
